nodes.text:
@VaishuramM Symptoms of HMPV infection
HMPV can cause a range of symptoms similar to other respiratory infections, including:

Cough
Runny or stuffy nose
Fever
Shortness of breath
Wheezing
Sore throat
Fatigue
In some cases, more severe symptoms like pneumonia or bronchiolitis can occur,
